abstract_research_topics.justification: Feature selection is typically considered an abstract research topic because it focuses on the theoretical methods for selecting the most relevant features in a data set, which is a fundamental problem in machine learning and not tied to any specific application.

Model parallelization deals with the theoretical approach to distributing different parts of a neural network across multiple processors, which is a topic of abstract research aimed at improving the efficiency of deep learning models.

Parallel computing involves the abstract concept of performing many calculations simultaneously, which is essential for running complex deep learning models efficiently but is not specific to any particular application area.

Parallelism refers to a theoretical concept of executing multiple operations at the same time, which is an important consideration in the efficiency of deep learning algorithms but not specific to any particular real-world application.
Operations research is an abstract domain that focuses on the application of analytical methods to help make better decisions, often formulated in terms of mathematical optimization.
A similar term to operation research, operations research is an abstract field that primarily involves theoretical methodologies for optimizing complex processes or systems.

application_domains.justification: This domain is clearly an application domain as it involves the practical application of deep learning techniques to create vehicles that can navigate and drive without human intervention.
This involves the application of deep learning in simulating environments to test and improve autonomous vehicle technologies, making it a practical real-world application domain.
As a subset of self-driving cars, autonomous driving directly relates to applying deep learning to develop vehicles that operate without human drivers.
This embodies the use of deep learning to create systems capable of performing tasks independently, applicable in various fields such as robotics and vehicles.
This refers to the use of deep learning in creating complete systems for vehicles to operate autonomously, thus falling under the application domains.
While operational research can be theoretical, in this context, it specifically refers to applying these techniques in the field of transportation, making it an application domain.
This domain is about applying deep learning to optimize and manage networks of transportation, which is a practical application area.
Refers to using deep learning for the practical enhancement and optimization of transportation infrastructures and systems.
A broad application domain where deep learning techniques can be used to improve efficiency and safety in various transportation methods.
This involves creating synthetic traffic scenarios with deep learning, used in training models for real-world applications, thus a practical domain.
A practical application domain where deep learning is used to optimize and control traffic flow through the management of signals.
A clear application domain where deep learning is used to improve targeting and efficacy of digital advertising campaigns.
Focuses on applying deep learning to enhance the functionality and performance of mobile apps, a practical usage.
This domain typically involves practical applications of parallel computing techniques in transmitting data efficiently, often used in communication systems.
Involves applying deep learning to the design of new hardware systems or optimizing existing ones, making it a practical application.
Engages deep learning techniques in improving systems and processes in the aerospace and automotive industries, identifying it as an application domain.
Applies deep learning in aerospace engineering for design, simulation, and operation, indicating a real-world application domain.
A general application domain where deep learning techniques are applied to solve complex engineering problems in various disciplines.
Involves applying deep learning in both engineering and robotic systems for development and improvement, clearly an application domain.
